tasks.label: Back up XAMPP Apache config
args: if not exist "F:\xamp\apache\conf\httpd.conf.before-laravel-vhost-20261101-002500.bak" copy "F:\xamp\apache\conf\httpd.conf" "F:\xamp\apache\conf\httpd.conf.before-laravel-vhost-20261101-002500.bak" && if not exist "F:\xamp\apache\conf\extra\httpd-vhosts.conf.before-laravel-vhost-20261101-002500.bak" copy "F:\xamp\apache\conf\extra\httpd-vhosts.conf" "F:\xamp\apache\conf\extra\httpd-vhosts.conf.before-laravel-vhost-20261101-002500.bak"

tasks.label: Run local Apache without service install
args: "F:\xamp\apache\bin\httpd.exe" -f "F:\xamp\apache\conf\httpd.conf" -t && "F:\xamp\apache\bin\httpd.exe" -f "F:\xamp\apache\conf\httpd.conf" -S && start "Laravel Apache local" "F:\xamp\apache\bin\httpd.exe" -f "F:\xamp\apache\conf\httpd.conf" && timeout /t 3 /nobreak >nul && netstat -ano | findstr "127.0.0.1:8000"
